description: Machine-readable per-version feature matrix for the Unity 6.x line. Single source of truth for the version-gated seams consumed by tools/shared/unity-version.ts and the version-matrix Sense ability.
verifyNote: Verify every version-gated flag against the Unity manual, the relevant upgrade guide, the package docs, and the project's Packages/manifest.json for the exact editor version. This matrix records OAC guidance, not a substitute for the primary docs.

features.label: URP is the default render pipeline
features.summary: Universal Render Pipeline is the default render pipeline in Unity 6.

features.label: Built-in Render Pipeline available
features.summary: Built-in is still supported in 6.0/6.3 but is deprecated in 6.5; new work should target URP or HDRP.

features.label: HDRP in maintenance mode
features.summary: High Definition Render Pipeline receives maintenance fixes only; prefer URP unless HDRP-only features are needed.

features.label: Built-in CGPROGRAM shaders deprecated
features.summary: New Built-in shaders must not use CGPROGRAM; use HLSLPROGRAM with URP/HDRP includes.

features.label: Awaitable built-in async primitive
features.summary: Awaitable is available as an allocation-light async primitive; preferred for new single-await code.

features.label: Entities/DOTS is a core package
features.summary: Entities 1.x ships as a core package rather than experimental.

features.label: UI Toolkit runtime is stable
features.summary: UI Toolkit runtime APIs are stable; UGUI remains the fallback.

features.label: UI Toolkit default for new runtime UI
features.summary: UI Toolkit is the default for new runtime UI; UGUI is supported for existing canvases.

features.label: Lighting Auto Generate setting
features.summary: The Lighting window 'Auto Generate' setting was removed in Unity 6; lighting is generated on demand.

features.label: Rigidbody.SetDensity/GetDensity
features.summary: Rigidbody density setters are deprecated as of the 6.3 line; set mass directly or use a collider-based approach.

features.label: _CLUSTER_LIGHT_LOOP shader keyword
features.summary: The _CLUSTER_LIGHT_LOOP shader keyword is deprecated as of the 6.3 line.

features.label: DirectX 12 default graphics API
features.summary: DirectX 12 became the default graphics API on Windows in the 6.3 cycle.
